c0-frame.title: Frame the cycle
c0-frame.imperative: Flavor: shotgun (human-confirmed). Target: a wide sweep of candidate simplification moves across the constellation skills corpus (~20 one-liners, wild entries sanctioned). Seed from EXPLORER_STARTING_QUESTIONS. Two research excursions dispatched in parallel (x1 external best practices, x2 corpus survey). Record pass when framed.
c0-frame.finding: shotgun cycle framed; two research excursions (x1 external best practices, x2 corpus survey) dispatched in background; starting questions q1-q5 queued

q1.title: The itch — what is actually bugging you about the skills as they stand?
q1.imperative: Starting question 1: describe the pain, not a solution. What made today the day? Ask with a recommended answer; record the finding on the board.
q1.finding: No specific pain. Rapid expansion prompts a periodic touch-up; the goal is PREVENTIVE - clean up before agents start struggling, not in response to an observed failure. Implication: this pass is corpus hygiene guided by external best practice + measurement, not incident response.

q2.title: For whom — who feels this, who decides it's solved?
q2.imperative: Starting question 2. Ask with a recommended answer; record the finding on the board.
q2.finding: Primary: the agents loading the skills (token cost per run; duplication-with-drift causes stale-wording follow). Secondary: maintainer (one place to patch doctrine, not 14). Human decides solved; real judge is downstream runs (f1brainz etc.) not tripping.

q3.title: What does done feel like?
q3.imperative: Starting question 3: describe the world once this is handled. Ask with a recommended answer; record the finding on the board.
q3.finding: Done = every SKILL.md reads as one deliberately-written doc absorbable in one pass; doctrine lives exactly once, skills point not restate; each skill visibly invoker-tailored; descriptions do the selection work. EXPLICITLY REJECTED: an anti-re-accretion convention as a goal. Accrete-then-consolidate is the accepted model - this is periodic maintenance; preventing re-layering would over-constrain and lose lessons. Open to lightweight organizing conventions but skeptical; not a success criterion.

q4.title: What already exists that partly addresses this?
q4.imperative: Starting question 4: prior simplification passes, existing conventions (SKILL.md short / templates as interface / references as doctrine). Ask with a recommended answer; record the finding on the board.
q4.finding: Existing bones are right: _shared/global-* refs, relationship contract (SKILL.md = trigger/boundary/pointer; templates = interface; references = doctrine), cartographer as the factoring exemplar. Adherence fell short: lessons landed inline, nothing deleted. AMENDMENT from human: superpowers skills on this box should be REMOVED as a dependency/influence - constellation is a competitor to superpowers; do not lean on their doctrine. NEW IDEA sanctioned by human: a skill that applies authoring doctrine to the corpus itself (periodic maintenance / apply-lessons skill) - carry into shotgun sweep.

q5.title: What would make this pointless — the kill condition?
q5.imperative: Starting question 5: name the kill condition now, test it early. Ask with a recommended answer; record the finding on the board.
q5.finding: Broad kill condition already dead (x2 proved corpus is not lean). Live narrow kill: if consolidation into _shared hurts agents at runtime (missing inline doctrine, pointer-chasing costs > duplication saved), the consolidation half dies, leaving per-skill tightening. Constraint accepted: consolidation must preserve what each role actually sees at runtime, checked not assumed.

x1.title: Excursion: external skill-authoring best practices (research)
x1.imperative: One named question: what do current (mid-2026) authoritative and community sources say makes an agent skill effective — beyond Pocock's three rules? Brief on board. Background dispatch via run_crew.py external backend + Agent tool. Result artifact: excursions/x1-best-practices.md. Scoped nulls apply.
x1.finding: x1 landed: 12 themes, cited. Top levers: description field quality (3rd person, triggers, exclusion clause); conciseness as first principle (<500 lines; obra tightens to <200-500 words); progressive disclosure one-hop-deep with TOCs; degrees-of-freedom matching; eval-driven authoring. 4 contradictions surfaced incl. Anthropic-vs-obra on workflow-in-description. Pocock video content itself NOT recovered (scoped null).

x2.title: Excursion: constellation corpus survey (research)
x2.imperative: One named question: where, concretely, is the constellation skills corpus heavy, layered, duplicated, or mis-tailored to its invoker (human vs agent)? Brief on board. Background dispatch via run_crew.py external backend + Agent tool. Result artifact: excursions/x2-corpus-survey.md. Scoped nulls apply.
x2.finding: x2 landed: corpus bimodal (commander 2580w / explorer 1695w / docent 152 lines heavy; 11 others lean). 9 duplication clusters incl. mandatory-boilerplate x10, engine-invocation string x10, FOLLOW-STRICTLY x6, scoped-nulls x2, unchanged-tree shortcut x2. Layering epicenter = commander (crew-backend 250w paragraph, idle-adjudication triple-stated) + admiral 12-bullet field-lessons list. Mis-tailoring: interrogator human-facing prose but agent-loaded; manifest.json lists 11/14 skills. Uncertainties: intent of tier-local restatements; template-body diffs not done.

consolidation.summary: Shotgun cycle 1: starting questions answered (preventive maintenance; agents primary beneficiaries; accrete-then-consolidate lifecycle accepted; superpowers = competitor, remove from box; narrow kill = _shared consolidation hurting runtime context). Two excursions landed (x1 external best practices, x2 corpus survey). 24 ideas generated; human kept ALL: clusters A single-sourcing dedup (1-10), B per-skill diets (11-15), C constellation-curator skill (23) absorbing tailoring/hygiene checklist (16-20), D hygiene quick fixes (21-22), E skill eval harness (24, tackle last). Open threads: superpowers/ROADMAP reconciliation; x1 contradictions to adjudicate; curator design shape.
